name: The Clash

whyMatters.en: Punk politics with a world-music appetite: The Clash prove the 'only band that matters' can be street corner and experiment booth at once.
whyMatters.zh: Punk 政治遇上世界音乐胃口：The Clash 证明「唯一重要的乐队」可以同时是街角与实验摊。

essentialTracks.title: Should I Stay or Should I Go

note.zh: 末世广播：Punk 的史诗化

scenes.track: Should I Stay or Should I Go

note.zh: 钩子与双语：Punk 也能写流行

lyricQuotes: London calling to the faraway towns

shortBio.en: Punk's expansionist sample—street heat with a passport.
shortBio.zh: Punk 的扩张主义样本——街头热度，带着护照。

body.en:
The Clash refuse to keep punk in a three-chord cage. Reggae, dub, rockabilly, and radio-ready hooks sit beside slogans that still smell like paint.

Street and laboratory share one leather jacket.
body.zh:
The Clash 拒绝把朋克关在三和弦笼子里。Reggae、dub、rockabilly 与电台钩子，和仍有油漆味的口号并排。

街头与实验室共穿一件皮衣。

title.en: The only band, and it keeps traveling
title.zh: 唯一乐队，而且一直在出门

body.en:
Political edge without tourist innocence: they borrow rhythms because the city already contains them, not because a brochure suggested spice.

Decisive punk expands. It does not purify itself into a museum accent.
body.zh:
政治锋利，却没有游客式天真：他们借用节奏，因为城市里本来就有，不是因为手册建议加点香料。

决定性的朋克会扩张。不会净化成博物馆口音。

body.en:
1979. The title track opens like a broadcast from a city that knows the water is rising. Punk learns epic scale without quitting the pavement.

The double album around it is appetite made visible—width as politics.
body.zh:
1979 年。标题曲像一座知道水在涨的城市发来的广播。Punk 学会史诗尺度，却不离开人行道。

周围的双专辑是胃口的可见化——宽本身就是政治。

title.en: Should I Stay: a hook with bilingual teeth
title.zh: Should I Stay：带双语牙的钩子

body.en:
A chorus anyone can shout; Spanish asides that keep it from becoming pure souvenir. Punk discovers it can write pop without washing off the grit.

The clash inside The Clash is the method: accessibility versus refusal to simplify the world.
body.zh:
谁都能喊的副歌；西班牙语插句不让它变成纯纪念品。Punk 发现能写流行，而不洗掉沙砾。

The Clash 内部的冲突就是方法：可接近，对简化世界说不。

body.en:
Later political guitar bands and indie cosmopolitans inherit the permission to mix without apology.

From hardcore slogans to dance-floor borrowings, the Clash map stays open—borders as material, not walls.
body.zh:
后来的政治吉他乐队与 Indie 世界主义者继承「混搭不必道歉」的许可。

从硬核口号到舞池借用，Clash 地图一直开着——边界是材料，不是墙。

title.en: Slogans that still smell like paint

body.en:
Strummer talk cuts like a leaflet handed out at midnight. The quotes work because they sound usable on a street, not framed in a gallery.

Keep them short. The band already hated empty monument talk.
body.zh:
Strummer 的话像午夜散发的传单。金句有效，因为它们听起来能在街上用，不是裱在画廊里。

保持短。这支乐队本就讨厌空洞纪念碑腔。

note.en: Punk grows up without losing urgency.
World music curiosity inside three-chord politics.
note.zh: 三和弦政治里塞进世界音乐好奇。
